title: RTK Query
description: Learn data fetching and caching with RTK Query.

data.text: **RTK Query** is a powerful data fetching and caching tool built into Redux Toolkit. It eliminates the need to hand-write data fetching logic.

data.title: RTK Query
Usage
Benefits
data.text: RTK Query handles caching, polling, prefetching, and invalidation automatically. It can replace both Redux async logic and React Query.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: RTK Query simplifies data fetching in Redux apps.
